newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico officials can't confirm lira bond reports.
newsitem.headline: Mexico officials can't confirm lira bond reports.

text.p: Mexican officials said on Wednesday they could not confirm local newspaper reports Mexico plans to issue a bond worth a reported 500 billion Italian lira.
A Finance Ministry official, who requested anonymity, told Reuters the government is considering a variety of debt issues.

"Our normal activity is to analyze different offers from different banks and in different markets. The Italian lira market is one of our alternatives, but at this moment we can't confirm anything about this," said the official.

Mexico City's Reforma newspaper reported on Wednesday the government would soon announce the issue of floating-rate notes with a maturity of five years. The newspaper quoted market sources in New York.
